name: Poster Parade
lore: The road heads out on a parade of old travel and park posters from the 1920s-40s: geysers, peaks and forests, wild animals and zoo animals, ski trails and snowy days, each one dug out a block at a time.
sourceNote: Real 1920s-40s WPA and travel posters from the Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs (rights advisory 'No known restrictions on publication', re-read per item); lane C's round 2 after the critic (critic-land-09.md): 13 picks, 8 of them re-cropped clear of all lettering (variant x3: np001 np007 np016 np050 np042 np040 np038 np018) and 10 dropped (np013 np014 np067 np051 np063 np035 np073 np046, and np019 np020 in round 1) (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/09-national-park-posters/README.md, picks-full.json, workspace 772784d), each a crop of the poster (srcCrop on its manifest line, information only), unedited; converted by land.js boardOf with the whole manifest line (chroma). The folder keeps lane C's slug (09); as installed it is Land 7 in the factory's numbering (levels 480-492, era 15) and Zen World 8.
eggNote: Eggs on the reused sheets' painted side-quest spur tips (tools/map-plan-v7.md section 5; the land has no side quests): eggTurns puts each sheet's 2 eggs on its template's 2 quest spots, each repeat its own pair, trimmed to the 2 sheets 13 levels use. Kinds for a park: woodpile (a campfire), raven, grass, owl, mushrooms.

zen.note: v7 lane D: Poster Parade (renamed from National Park Posters, Peter 2026-10-13; the folder keeps its slug) plays as Zen World 8 (tools/land.js ... zen writes tools/build-data/levels/zen.json only). Records keep the land factory numbers 480-492 (scratch/state.json seeded {from: 480, sheet0: 64, gal0: 62}: Worlds 1-7 hold 1-50, 201-250, 251-300, 301-350, 351-400, 401-429, 430-479; World 7's sheets end at 63); the page shows them on from World 7's last Zen number (Zen 330-342, main.js zenNum); zen.numbered keys each licence row by its Zen picture number before its level.

profile.note: Zen World 8, casual (v7 lane D, 2026-10-13): World 6 The Floating World's profile as it ships (tools/lands/07-floating-world/land.json; real art, max-box boards): tags in World 6's short-world shares (0.36 / 0.50 / 0.14) for E5/N6/H2 at 13 (round 2; E8/N10/H3 at 21 in round 1), ending on a Hard; ? cards, linked squads, gentle moats (2 ways in) only on posters that can carry and deal one; no locks, no archers, no Extreme, no mystery blocks (Peter, 2026-10-08); careful floor 0.5 every tag; World 5's deal setting for max-box boards (squads 1.6x, 400 attempts).
